summary: Implemented OBS-04 frontend timeline support in the Instance Detail view with API integration to GET /api/v1/instances/:id/timeline, typed timeline models, query hook/state handling, paginated load-more behavior via next_cursor, and timeline presentation with actor/description/context/metadata. Added a pure utility test suite for timeline display helpers. Required frontend validations were executed successfully: npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run test, npm run build.
